intro.text: A dark, violet light used by the enemy, much as Stormlight is used by Surgebinders.
The dark, violet light of Odium's forces. It's stored in gemstones like Stormlight and powers the Surges of the Fused.

description.text: Voidlight is a dark light the enemy depends on to power their transformations.
Voidlight is a dark, violet-on-black glow. On a person it spreads over the skin instead of sinking in, and someone filled with it leaves violet trails as they move.

items.text: Ba-Ado-Mishram is said to have once supplied Voidlight to the parsh people.
Leaving gemstones out in the Everstorm doesn't fill them with Voidlight, and the Fused arrive already full of it.
A singer can make a sphere of Voidlight by singing the Song of Prayer, though doing so draws Odium's attention.
Voidlight is stored in gemstones like Stormlight, but the two can't share a gem. It leaks much more slowly than Stormlight.
Instead of an urge to move, Voidlight brings stronger passion and more vivid emotions. In a singer it fills mainly the gemheart.
Humans can draw in Voidlight if they know its pure tone and rhythm.
Its rhythm is chaotic, but with a certain logic to it.
Anti-Voidlight glows a faint violet-black and seems to warp the air around it. When it meets Voidlight, both are destroyed in an explosion.
Like Stormlight, Voidlight heals the person filled with it, and the Fused use it to power their Surges as a Surgebinder uses Stormlight.
Voidlight powers some, if not all, of the special powers of the Regal forms.
Several Unmade are linked to Voidlight: bonding Yelig-nar grows violet crystals and a gemheart pulsing with it, and the sphere holding Nergaoul glows dark purple.
Larkin can feed on Voidlight with no ill effects.
